name: Refrigerated multipurpose centrifuge
name_zh: CHEM-010 冷冻多用途离心机 Eppendorf 5910 Ri
license: CC BY-NC 4.0; third-party exceptions in NOTICE.md
author: ChemLab-Assets authors; source-specific credits retained in contract/NOTICE.md
package_scope: Complete selected model directory and URDF mesh dependencies; external runtime references are not activated

articulation.axis_frame: axis_node_local_gltf and joint_axis_local use Y-up glTF; axis_joint_frame/joint_axis use Blender Z-up; canonical URDF FK at q=0

axis: X right, Y back, Z up in Blender; standard Y-up glTF export

dimension_evidence.basis: source digital mesh closed-pose bounds; not calibrated manufacturer CAD

surface_check.method: Actual evaluated vertices to triangles in both directions, closed pose; Euclidean metres; all posed transforms independently checked

assembly.units: m at asset root; local translation units follow accumulated parent scale
assembly.axis_metadata: joint_axis uses Blender Z-up node local coordinates; glTF Y-up equivalent is [x,z,-y]
